limitations: Adaptive reused development and earlier STOP/CV tuning. Raw fold-local preprocessing prevents direct vocabulary/CTR leakage, but inherited tree/correction/temperature controls were selected using these authorized rows previously: fold errors are a selection criterion, not unbiased external estimates. Equal fit counts do not equal compute, capacity or effective regularization. Different fixed corrections can be suboptimal on folds. Models with fixed leaf corrections are inference artifacts; historical training metrics are not recomputed. Same-split seed sensitivity is not independent replication, significance, TabArena ranking or a universal claim. Named arrays are conservative accounting, not a whole-process RAM bound.

quiet_baseline_memory.context: Activation coordinator must ensure no fits/builds/timings overlap this snapshot

selection: Five shared raw folds (split seed18018) over each task's exact current authorized fitting rows: originalTRAIN, originalSTOP, then ascending authorized outside-cap rows where present. Relearn vocabulary and CT ordered transformations only on each foldTRAIN. Independently fit ceil(n/2), n,2n requested rounds around the current count; preserve duplicate profiles. One owned process per fit,540 fits total. Recompute only inherited fixed correction controls on that foldTRAIN with certified numerical solver, no new correction grid; preserve fixed multiclassT once. Mean five primary fold errors selects count, ties fewer rounds then profile index. Freeze all36 choices before36 fresh mandatory full-current-union fits; no early stopping, tree slicing, parent fallback or DEV selection.

target.description: Exploratory development target, not general ranking or a claim of statistical equivalence
